metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2015 · The Little Prince
metas.description: A little girl lives in a very grown-up world with her mother, who tries to prepare her for it. Her neighbor, the Aviator, introduces the girl to an extraordinary world where anything is possible, the world of the Little Prince.

metas.name: 2026 · The Golden Ticket
metas.description: Follows contestants who will compete to gain entry into a "retro-futuristic" chocolate factory by obtaining golden tickets. Once inside, they will face various challenges.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2026 · The Dog Stars
metas.description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a virus wipes out humanity. Survivors face roaming scavengers called Reapers. Protagonist Hig, a pilot, survived the flu but lost his wife.

metas.name: 2026 · Wildwood
metas.description: The adventures of Prue McKeel as she sets off to the forests outside Portland to find her kidnapped brother.
